convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management and money management logic. Multi-mode money management with conditional logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Historical bar scan: when both open and close on same side are enabled and no immediate close signal, EA scans backward bars to find prior opposite signal for closing. Up signal (buffer 1) triggers SELL_Close; Dn signal (buffer 0) triggers BUY_Close.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1); FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; BALANCE=fraction of balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Logic is in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads the wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator on a configurable bar index (SignalBar, default=1 meaning previous bar). When no immediate close signal is found but both open and close flags are enabled for a side, it performs a backward scan through all bars from SignalBar+1 onward to find a prior reversal signal for closing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are configurable input booleans that gate whether the EA can open/close long/short positions. The custom indicator has 2 buffers: buffer 0 = down signal (DnValue), buffer 1 = up signal (UpValue). Signal times are computed as last bar date + one timeframe period, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade identification.
python_conversion_notes: The wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator must be ported to Python or its logic reverse-engineered (Bill Williams WiseMan-2 signal based on updown parameter). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented. The conditional money management (5 MarginMode variants) requires careful translation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips appear to be in points not pips - verify if digit adjustment is needed. Signal time tracking logic used for trade identification must be replicated or replaced with position-based tracking.
